en-US.name: Stoop Shop
en-US.summary: Sell things from your porch: hear offers, approve sales and follow pickups by voice.
en-US.description: Stoop sells the things you photograph to people nearby. Its AI assistant prices them and haggles within your rules, and buyers pick up from your porch while you're out. Your money is released once your porch camera sees the item go. With this skill you can hear new offers, accept or decline them, set your lowest price and follow a pickup, hands free. Open a shop at the Stoop website first, then say: Alexa, open stoop shop, and tell it the six digit code from your shop page.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask stoop shop if I have any offers
Alexa, ask stoop shop how my sale is going

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open a shop at https://d29kyjvj1jibpu.cloudfront.net/sell, add a photo and list it, open the listing link in a second browser and make an offer. On the shop page, tap Get a Code under Alexa. Then: 'open stoop shop', say the six digits, 'do I have any offers', 'yes', 'yes', 'how is my sale going'. Payments are test-only; nothing is charged.
